'''Outpost Skyline''' was a base used by the [[Voss commandos]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Western Watchwoods]] in the [[Gormak Lands]], a region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Skyline appears as the Imperial base in the Gormak Lands on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
